title: 校园事务对话词汇
goal: 理解校园事务词汇及对话中的手续和解决办法。

points.label: 理解校园事务中的常用词
听懂校园对话的要求和处理办法

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 长对话材料的教学依据

body.p: 校园事务对话涉及课程作业、图书馆服务和住宿安排。听手续时分清三件事：谁提出要求，要做什么，结果如何。

body.box:
A: Can I renew this book?
B: Yes. Please show me your library card.

body.p: renew 表示续借。show me your library card 是工作人员提出的手续要求。

cards.title: 词汇表：课程作业
rows: The assignment is due on Monday.
The course meets twice a week.
Ask the instructor about the topic.
The grade appears on the form.
Bring a draft to the meeting.
Choose a topic for the report.
The schedule shows the class times.

cards.title: 词汇表：图书馆服务
rows: Return the book at the desk.
Search the catalog for the title.
The dictionary is on that shelf.
The book is overdue by a day.
Pay the fine at the desk.
The room is available at noon.

cards.title: 词汇表：住宿事务
rows: Pay the deposit before moving in.
Fill in the form at the office.
Collect the key at the desk.
The room inspection is on Friday.

body.box:
Student: I'd like to renew this book. It's due tomorrow, but I need it for my assignment.
Librarian: Let me check your card. Another reader has reserved the book, so I can't renew it.
Student: Is another copy available?
Librarian: Yes. Return this one, and I'll lend you the copy on the shelf.
Student: Thank you. I'll return this book now.

How can the student continue to use the book?
1. Keep the reserved copy past its due date.
2. Borrow another copy after returning this one.
3. Renew the reserved copy using another card.
4. Ask the other reader to return the book.

body.p: Another reader has reserved the book 说明原书不能续借。lend you the copy on the shelf 是借另一册的办法，即第二项。

lines.text: When is the assignment due?
The deadline is Monday.

options: The subject of the assignment
The final time for submitting work
The day the assignment is given out
The marks given for the assignment
items.why: 问句问作业何时 due，答句用 deadline 回答。deadline 指提交的截止时间，即第二项。

lines.text: Can I renew this book?
Yes, you can keep it another week.

options: Borrow a different book for a week
Return the book within a week
Keep the book for a longer period
Reserve the book for next week
items.why: 依据是 keep it another week：书可以再留一周，renew 就是续借、延长借期，即第三项。

lines.text: When do I pay the deposit?
Before you move into the room.

items.stem: What is the deposit in this conversation?
options: A payment made before moving in
A payment made after moving out
The date for moving into the room
The room the student moves into
items.why: 依据是 pay the deposit 和 Before you move into the room。deposit 是入住前交的押金，即第一项。

lines.text: Where can I find the librarian's comments?
The feedback is on the form.

options: The form the comments are written on
The place where the form is found
The librarian who wrote on the form
The comments the librarian wrote
items.why: 问句说 the librarian's comments，答句用 feedback 指同一内容，即第四项。第一项是写意见的表格，不是意见本身。

lines.text: I'd like to reserve a study room for my group.
What day do you need it?
Thursday afternoon, if possible.
The large room is occupied, but the small room is free.
The small one is fine. How do I reserve it?
Please fill in this form and show your library card.
I'll do that now.
Then I'll confirm the booking for Thursday.

items.stem: Which room will the student request?
options: The large room on Thursday
The small room on Thursday
The large room on Friday
The small room on Friday
items.why: 依据是 The small room is free 和 The small one is fine，学生要的是周四的小房间，即第二项。

items.stem: What must the student do to reserve the room?
options: Choose a day and ask for the large room
Bring the whole group to the desk
Fill in a form and show a library card
Confirm the booking on Thursday afternoon
items.why: 依据是 Please fill in this form and show your library card，这是预约手续，即第三项。第四项的确认预订由馆员来做。

items.stem: The instructor asked for a draft before the final report. What is a draft?
options: An early version of the report
The final version of the report
The instructor's comments on the report
The final grade given for the report
items.why: 题干说 a draft before the final report。draft 是定稿之前的草稿，即第一项。

items.stem: A student must renew a library book. What does renew mean?
options: Borrow the book for the first time
Extend the loan of the book
Find the book in the catalog
Return the book to the shelf
items.why: renew 指续借，也就是延长借期，即第二项。

items.stem: A book is overdue. What does this mean?
options: The book can be borrowed now.
The book is due back next week.
The book is past its due date.
The book is reserved for a reader.
items.why: overdue 指超过了归还期限，即第三项。

items.stem: The housing office requires a deposit. What is it?
options: The rent paid each month for the room
The form completed to apply for a room
The receipt given after paying rent
Money held as security for the room
items.why: deposit 在住宿事务中指押金，是为房间交的保证金，即第四项。第一项是每月的租金 rent。

items.stem: A student wants to register for a course. What does the student want to do?
options: Enroll as a student in the course
Drop the course before it begins
Check the course schedule online
Submit the course assignment
items.why: register for a course 指注册、选上这门课，即第一项。

items.stem: A room has a vacancy. What does this indicate?
options: The room needs an inspection.
No one has taken the place yet.
The rent has already been paid.
The room's key has been returned.
items.why: vacancy 在住宿事务中指空房或空位，还没有人住，即第二项。

lines.text: This dictionary is due tomorrow. I need it for my assignment. Can I renew it?
Let me check. Another student has reserved this copy, so it needs to come back tomorrow. I can look for another copy in the catalog.
I need a dictionary until next Friday, when I submit my assignment. I can return this copy now.
There's another one on the shelf. Please return the first copy at this desk, and then I'll lend you the other one for two weeks.
Thank you. Here's my library card and the book.
I'll take those. The other copy will be ready in a moment.
That's enough time for my assignment.
Yes. The new due date will appear on your receipt.

items.stem: Why can't the student renew the first copy?
options: The student needs it until next Friday.
The book is already overdue.
Another student has reserved it.
Only one copy is left on the shelf.
items.why: 依据是 Another student has reserved this copy。原书已有别人预约，所以不能续借，即第三项。

items.stem: What solution does the librarian offer?
options: Renewing the first copy until next Friday
Holding the shelf copy until tomorrow
Keeping both copies for two weeks
Swapping the first copy for the shelf copy
items.why: 依据是 return the first copy 和 I'll lend you the other one。先还原书，再借书架上的另一册，即第四项。

lines.text: Good morning. I'm moving into a campus residence next Saturday, and I'd like to know when I can collect my key.
First, please complete the housing form and pay the deposit. Bring the receipt to this office, and we can give you the key.
I completed the form yesterday. Can I pay the deposit at this desk?
Payments are made at the cashier's office next door. It's open until four today. Keep the receipt after you pay.
I'll go there now and bring the receipt back before four.
That works. The key will be available here once we have seen the receipt.
Is the room inspection on Saturday too?
Yes, the inspection is scheduled for Saturday morning.

items.stem: What has the student already completed?
options: The housing application form
The payment of the deposit
The collection of the room key
The inspection of the residence
items.why: 依据是 I completed the form yesterday，表格昨天已经填好，即第一项。

items.stem: What must the student bring to the housing office to collect the key?
options: The schedule for the inspection
The receipt for the deposit
The key from the cashier
The completed housing form
items.why: 依据是 Bring the receipt to this office, and we can give you the key，交来押金收据才能领钥匙，即第二项。
